# C.U.D. Experience

> C.U.D. Experience (short for "Curated Human Experiences", usually written C.U.D.) is a small, independent slow-travel brand created and curated by Piotr Paweł Kamiński. Piotr designs and personally hosts small-group experiences in Asia (Vietnam, Indonesia, Cambodia) built around real conversations, local culture and unhurried days. Its currently open experience, C.U.D. Origins™ Founding Edition, takes place in Hoi An, Vietnam, on 20–30 March 2027 for a maximum of 9 guests. The website is available in English and Polish.

Key facts:
- Positioning: "Travel slower. Feel deeper. Return to yourself." C.U.D. is not about escaping your life; it is about returning to yourself.
- Three ways to experience C.U.D.: C.U.D. Experiences (small-group experiences in Asia), The C.U.D. Collection (places across Asia that Piotr has personally visited and selected) and C.U.D. Private Journeys (individually designed journeys across Asia). Piotr personally designs and curates journeys around the people travelling.
- Status: cudexperience.com is an informational website. According to its Terms of Use it is not a travel agency, tour operator or booking platform, and applying through the site does not create a booking; any arrangement for an actual trip is a separate, personal agreement with Piotr.
- If this file and a linked page ever disagree, the page is correct.

## Experiences

- [C.U.D. Hoi An Experience (C.U.D. Origins™ Founding Edition)](https://cudexperience.com/experiences/hoi-an/): the open experience. 20–30 March 2027, 10 nights, 9 guests maximum, in a private riverside sanctuary with tropical gardens close to Hoi An. Seven private sleeping spaces (five rooms in the main villa, two private cottages for two), prices, what is included, who it is for and 14 FAQ answers.
- [Apply to join the Hoi An experience](https://cudexperience.com/experiences/hoi-an/apply/): application form. Every application is read personally by Piotr.
- [All experiences](https://cudexperience.com/experiences/): Hoi An is open; C.U.D. Bali Experience (September 2027), C.U.D. Surf & Ride Bali (June 2027) and C.U.D. Kampot (December 2027) are announced, with details and dates still being finalised.

## The Collection and Private Journeys

- [The C.U.D. Collection](https://cudexperience.com/collection/): "Places worth travelling for." A growing, personal selection of boutique hotels, villas, guesthouses and hideaways across Asia that Piotr has personally visited, experienced and selected for genuine hospitality, a sense of place, thoughtful details, local connection and meaningful memories. It is not a ranking and not a list of the most luxurious places in Asia. The collection grows slowly, only when a place feels right.
- [C.U.D. Private Journeys](https://cudexperience.com/private-journeys/): "Asia, personally designed around you." Individually designed journeys across Asia, personally curated by Piotr around the people travelling, the way they want to travel and what they want to experience. There is no fixed itinerary and no standard package; each journey begins with a conversation. Private Journeys are individually quoted based on destination, duration, style of travel and level of curation. They will be available soon; enquiries go to contact@cudexperience.com.

## Hoi An facts (C.U.D. Origins™ Founding Edition)

- Dates and group: 20–30 March 2027; 9 guests plus Piotr. Solo travellers (five of the seven spaces are for one person) and pairs (two cottages) are both welcome.
- Prices per space in PLN: Presence 19,500; Wonder 19,500; Stillness 20,400; Becoming 18,900; Return 18,900. Per couple: Connection 37,800; Belonging 31,800.
- Payment: a 30% deposit secures a place and the balance is paid in agreed instalments before departure. Applications close 30 November 2026.
- Included: 10 nights in a private sanctuary, daily breakfast, selected lunches and dinners, a Chef Dining Experience, local culinary experiences, 2 massages, aerial yoga and movement sessions, rice fields and cycling, Hoi An Old Town, local markets, a coconut boat experience, a tea ceremony, curated group experiences, airport transfer, local transport, a C.U.D. Gift Box, photography and film moments, and personal support before and during the journey.
- Not included: international flights, travel insurance, alcohol and personal spending.
- Getting there: the closest airport is Da Nang International Airport (DAD), about 45 minutes from Hoi An. The full day-by-day itinerary is shared only after an application is accepted.

## About the brand

- [Home](https://cudexperience.com/): overview of the brand, its philosophy and upcoming 2027 experiences.
- [Philosophy](https://cudexperience.com/philosophy/): the five pillars (slow living, human connection, local culture, meaningful experiences, returning to yourself).
- [About C.U.D.](https://cudexperience.com/about/): why C.U.D. exists.
- [What Is Slow Travel?](https://cudexperience.com/slow-travel/): a short guide to slow travel in Asia: what it is, how to start, and how C.U.D. approaches it (Polish: [Czym jest slow travel?](https://cudexperience.com/pl/slow-travel/)).
- [Journal](https://cudexperience.com/journal/): "Shades of Human Life", stories and reflections. The latest entries are loaded by script and published on travelpixiefreak.com (https://travelpixiefreak.com/category/shades-of-human-life/).
- [Contact](https://cudexperience.com/contact/): contact@cudexperience.com for experiences, partnerships, the C.U.D. Collection and C.U.D. Private Journeys. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cudexperience/ LinkedIn (Piotr): https://www.linkedin.com/in/piotr-kaminski-pl/

- [C.U.D. Private Journeys](https://cudexperience.com/pl/private-journeys/): indywidualnie projektowane podróże po Azji, osobiście dobierane przez Piotra wokół osób, które w nie wyruszają. Wkrótce dostępne.
